dimensions.evidence: Lead is "Δ54-55 dual-PMO product"; backup "Δ55-56 two-PMO cocktail"; 16-row computed table (54-55 345bp/115aa, 55-56, 52-55, 49-55, 50-55, 47-55…) with large skips explicitly deprioritised: "6-7 oligos is unjustifiable before 2-exon options are exhausted."

"Junction fuses R21 2580-2624 to R22 2740-2802: in-phase 108-aa hybrid repeat; cysteine-rich, WW, C-terminal and Dp71 intact"; Kaspar DCM onset 43y for exon 50-55 deletions; Fortunato exon ≤55 permissive limit; Dmd Δ52-55 mouse rescue; out-of-phase junction DCM 26y vs 36y.

"naked PMO barely reaches cardiomyocytes, so lead delivery is an anti-TfR1 conjugate"; Dyne Fab-PMO and Avidity AOC profiled on reach/human PD/dose/frequency/tox/access; PPMO rejected for hypomagnesaemia+eGFR; explicit "Payload vs delivery" split (delivery- vs amenability- vs potency-driven).

"DYNE-255, exon-55 Fab-PMO with in vitro skipping, is IND-enabling"; del-zota/AOC 1044 with Novartis acquisition closed Feb 2026; plus Entrada EEV, Wave WVE-N531, PBGENE-DMD exon 45-55 excision, brogidirsen, SRP-5051 discontinuation, 5D-ASO.

"LEAD — Δ54-55 dual-PMO product… validate naked, carry forward as anti-TfR1 Fab-PMO conjugates for cardiac coverage" with Δ52-55 (only in vivo rescue) and Δ55-56 as named backups and stated costs; large cocktails explicitly WATCH/REJECT.

Patient + isogenic PTC lines; arms = exon-54 alone, exon-55 alone, pair at ratios, connected molecule; long-read amplicon product distribution, junction ddPCR, NMD, western; "Kill: Single-exon intermediates dominate… Then switch to Δ52-55"; cardiac exposure as go/no-go.
722 words, scannable headers (Recommendation / Delivery / Backup / Critical risk / First experiment / Key precedents), bullets carry quantitative substance; no literature-review padding.

unacceptable_failures.note: 45-55-class options ranked WATCH only; "6-7 oligos is unjustifiable before 2-exon options are exhausted."

DYNE-255 exon-55 Fab-PMO IND-enabling; PBGENE-DMD 45-55 excision covering exon-55 genotypes.

unacceptable_failures.failure: recommends a splice product without evaluating protein functionality
unacceptable_failures.note: Repeat phasing, hinge-3 status, Dp71/WW/CR integrity, Becker/DCM-onset data and mouse rescue assessed per product.

unacceptable_failures.failure: produces a long literature review instead of a program recommendation
unacceptable_failures.note: 722-word decision memo with verdict, lead, backups, kill criteria; evidence confined to the appendix.

summary: Hits every required discovery. Lands the minimal 54+55 lead over 55+56 and larger blocks, interrogates coordinated skipping and correctly discounts the single unquantified co-skip claim, reasons on repeat phasing and Becker/DCM evidence rather than frame alone, puts TfR1 conjugates at the centre with naked PMO as a justified fallback, and finds DYNE-255. Refuses exon-44 transfer explicitly. 14/14 — pass. Minor gap: Δ55-56 is not run head-to-head in the first experiment.
